scope: Daily edition publication, approved reader presentation, private operations, and watchlist monitoring

private_operations.authentication: Supported existing Sites dispatch authentication without interactive sign-in
private_operations.prepublication: Owner priorities retrieved and 90-day comment retention cleanup completed
private_operations.postpublication: Current aggregate snapshot and edition usage will be saved only after the exact live content SHA passes QA
private_operations.credit_measurement: Unavailable: no edition-attributable credit or dollar measurement was provided

reading: All six selected source main texts have reviewed source-reading estimates at 200 words per minute; the brief never substitutes its own summary length.
reader_presentation: The watchlist preview is expanded after the podcast and before Editorial takeaway. Book wording uses the approved Leanpub disclosure and call to action. Permanent item pages preserve stable IDs and canonical share URLs.
watchlist: All 49 registered sources were checked. Thirty-five returned candidate links; assisted-review, no-link and unavailable outcomes remain explicit and do not imply an absence of news.
historical_analytics: Blocked pending separate owner approval; no indirect migration was attempted.
